svg.title: Average AP power vs. delivered throughput
svg.desc: Static LCM and HCM observations under two sets of state powers.

g.text: Average AP power vs. delivered throughput
1 AP · 1 STA · 1500 B periodic downlink · HE SU MCS 7, GI 0.8 μs · 15 s per run
Markers = three-seed means · Blue band = LCM after crossover
LCM after crossover: 23.97–32.06 Mb/s · 8.13 to 8.38 W
LCM after crossover: 22.15–32.06 Mb/s · 9.15 to 10.12 W
Crossovers use interpolation between equal-throughput observations. Measured limits: LCM 32.06 Mb/s · HCM 46.33 Mb/s.
